front: Flood your eidolon with power to grant a temporary evolution such as new senses, speeds or size.
back:
Choose one for 1 min:
- low-light vision and darkvision
- scent (imprecise, 30 ft)
- breathe underwater and swim Speed = land Speed or 30 ft (min); aquatic eidolons breathe air and gain land Speed; amphibious
- +20-foot status bonus to Speed
Heightened (3rd) adds: Large (reach 10 ft; you can ride it) or climb Speed = land Speed.
(5th) adds: Huge (reach 15 ft) or fly Speed = Speed.
